description:
Hippos only eat grass, yet they are counted among the deadliest large animals in Africa. Doug starts eleven thousand kilometers away in Colombia and walks the whole distance down to zero: the honk, the night walk, the charge, the red sweat, the yawn, the riverbed, the canoe, two fighting bulls and, finally, the open mouth.

Which animal should Doug stay away from next? Tell us in the comments.
Subscribe so you don't miss Doug's next terrible decision.
